sourceNotes.database: Successful retained source observations through the fixed cutoff; failed refreshes are absent, not fabricated zeros. Most coverage is under 10 hours on one day. Regional evening is a proxy, not a known event timetable.
sourceNotes.supplement: Independent RedMMetrics embedded UTC chart data, captured separately by overview_data; not BrowseRP database history. Six complete UTC days 2026-08-29 through 2026-09-03. A qualifying day has at least 3 samples >=35; it is not a continuous-session or average claim.
sourceNotes.mutations: Read-only review. Decisions are recommendations, not evidence that listings were archived.
